vuln.name: CSP Allows unsafe-eval
vuln.description: The Content-Security-Policy script-src directive permits 'unsafe-eval', allowing eval(), Function(), and setTimeout(string). Many template and compilation libraries require it, but it widens the XSS attack surface.
vuln.impact: If an attacker can inject script, unsafe-eval makes it easier to execute dynamic payloads and bypass some CSP-based controls.
vuln.recommendation: Remove 'unsafe-eval' from script-src. Refactor code that depends on eval / new Function to avoid dynamic code generation.
